'AI-driven' is the coverage's framing (NBC and others), so this is headlines-only, not inference. Microsoft's own memo says “the roles eliminated today are not being replaced by AI” while stating “AI is changing how work gets done. Some of the tasks we do every day can now be automated,” and gives realignment-to-priorities reasons; the Xbox memo (the largest component) cites Xbox's margins and Game Pass economics and contains zero AI references. Press (e.g., NBC: “latest AI-driven tech layoffs”) attributes more than the firm claims.
